messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Metoprolol is FDA-approved to treat high blood pressure, angina, heart failure, and heart attack.
The two forms are not approved for the same conditions.
Condition | Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release) | Metoprolol succinate (extended release)
High blood pressure (hypertension) in adults | Yes | Yes
High blood pressure in children 6 years and older | No | Yes
Angina (chest pain) | Yes | Yes
Heart failure | No | Yes
Heart attack (myocardial infarction) | Yes | No
High blood pressure (hypertension).
Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events.
These events mainly include strokes and heart attacks.
Metoprolol can be used on its own or with other blood pressure medicines.
Many people need more than one medicine to reach their blood pressure goal.
Angina.
Metoprolol is used for long-term treatment of angina.
It is used to reduce how often attacks happen.
It is used to help you do more before chest pain starts.
Metoprolol is not used to stop an attack that has already begun.
Heart failure.
Triples: [["Metoprolol", "fda approved to treat", "high blood pressure"], ["Metoprolol", "fda approved to treat", "angina"], ["Metoprolol", "fda approved to treat", "heart failure"], ["Metoprolol", "fda approved to treat", "heart attack"], ["Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release)", "not approved for", "high blood pressure in children 6 years and older"], ["Metoprolol succinate (extended release)", "approved for", "high blood pressure in children 6 years and older"], ["Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release)", "approved for", "high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults"], ["Metoprolol succinate (extended release)", "approved for", "high blood pressure (hypertension) in adults"], ["Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release)", "approved for", "angina (chest pain)"], ["Metoprolol succinate (extended release)", "approved for", "angina (chest pain)"], ["Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release)", "not approved for", "heart failure"], ["Metoprolol succinate (extended release)", "approved for", "heart failure"], ["Metoprolol tartrate (immediate release)", "approved for", "heart attack (myocardial infarction)"], ["Metoprolol succinate (extended release)", "not approved for", "heart attack (myocardial infarction)"], ["high blood pressure (hypertension)", "reduces risk of", "fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events"], ["fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events", "mainly include", "strokes"], ["fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events", "mainly include", "heart attacks"], ["Metoprolol", "can be used with", "other blood pressure medicines"], ["Metoprolol", "used for long term treatment of", "angina"], ["Metoprolol", "used to reduce frequency of", "angina attacks"], ["Metoprolol", "used to help perform more activity before", "chest pain starts"], ["Metoprolol", "not used to stop", "angina attack that has already begun"]]
Relations: ["approved for", "can be used with", "fda approved to treat", "mainly include", "not approved for", "not used to stop", "reduces risk of", "used for long term treatment of", "used to help perform more activity before", "used to reduce frequency of"]
Answer:

completion:
approved for: The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
can be used with: The subject drug may be combined with or administered alongside the substance or medication specified by the object entity.
fda approved to treat: The subject drug is approved by the FDA for the treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
mainly include: The medical condition or event specified by the subject entity primarily consists of the events or conditions specified by the object entity.
not approved for: The subject drug is not approved for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
not used to stop: The subject drug is not used to halt or terminate the event or condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject medical condition or treatment is associated with a reduction in the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
used for long term treatment of: The subject drug is used for the long-term management or treatment of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
used to help perform more activity before: The subject drug is used to enable the patient to perform more physical activity before the event specified by the object entity occurs.
used to reduce frequency of: The subject drug is used to decrease the occurrence or frequency of the event or condition specified by the object entity.
